_about: Audit of every closed enum with more than 12 members (reviewer, 13 Sep 2026: 'list the members, mark the ones that are not values of that quantity'). Read by the parent from FIELD_DICTIONARY on db24763. A mark is a finding for a dictionary decision (term 4 field definition / term 6 duplicate cup), not a change: nothing is removed from a domain here, because removing a member refuses stored values and goes through syncDictionaryOn with the cross-vendor measurement.

ip_rating.detail: The IEC 60529 grid (first digit 0-6 or X, second 0-8 or X) plus ISO 20653 IP69K. 80 is the size of the standard's grid, not padding. Members that no network product carries in practice (ip00-ip08, ip0x, ip1x-ip3x) are legal codes and stay: a closed domain that refused a legal code would refuse a real rating. Missing: ipx9 / ip69 (IEC 60529:2013 amendment) — not added without a stored value asking for it.

standard.detail: The msa_or_vendor_names members are real names a datasheet prints (Cisco 'lite', 'CSR', 'BiDi'), so they are values of the quantity as vendors write it; they are marked because they are not IEEE 802.3 clause names and two members can denote one PMD (40gbase-bidi / 40gbase-sr-bidi).

cellular_bands.verdict: generated as a numeric grid — NEEDS a check against 3GPP; not asserted member by member here
cellular_bands.detail: b1-b88 (LTE), n1-n106 + n257-n262 (NR), umts-b1-b32, gsm-850/900/1800/1900. A contiguous numeric range almost certainly contains band numbers 3GPP never assigned or has reserved (TS 36.101 for LTE, TS 38.101-1/-2 for NR, TS 25.101 for UMTS). Those members are not values of the quantity. The parent has not verified the assignment table and does not mark individual numbers from memory; the check is: every member present in the TS band tables, else removed (no stored Cisco value holds an unassigned number, measured before any change).

regulatory_domain.detail: The single letters are Cisco AP regulatory-domain suffix codes (-A, -B, -E, …); nam-lam, row and universal are Meraki/Catalyst region names.
